title: Tower direct-image acyclicity of restricted K-injective coefficient systems
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism, and source a SystemRestrictionData record on $X$ as in [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models]. Let $c:R_Y\to f_*R_X$ be a completed-ring structural map whose module pushforward is additive. For any RightImage model $T$ of its levelwise tower pushforward and every K-injective cochain complex $I$ of strict coefficient systems [def-pur-kinjective-complex], the component $T.\mathrm{unit}_{\mathrm{source.systemRestriction}(I)}$ is an isomorphism. This statement constructs no ordinary system pushforward and no comparison square.

proof.text: Identify source.finiteIso with the canonical finite coefficient isomorphism by sheafification extensionality and finiteIso_generator. Its completed projections form a compatible cone. Present strict systems as modules over the quotient-ring sequence site, and constant completed-module towers as modules on the constant completed-ring sequence site. The section identities and successor transitions in SystemRestrictionData give a natural isomorphism identifying systemRestriction with restriction along this cone.

Choose a K-injective resolution j of the restricted complex. Transport the original system and the resolution along the sequence-site equivalences. Over each sequence-site object, restrict to its slice; exact slice restriction preserves j and preserves K-injectives. Apply scalar-restriction acyclicity for global sections on that slice. Since its terminal object is the chosen object, this proves j is a quasi-isomorphism on sections at every level and every pro-etale object.

At each level, pushforward evaluates j on the same section complexes over pro-etale base changes. Sectionwise detection and levelwise detection therefore show that tower pushforward sends j to a quasi-isomorphism. The derived unit is invertible on the K-injective resolution; naturality at j, and invertibility of Q(j) and Q(push(j)), imply invertibility of the supplied unit on the restricted complex.

lean.statement:
theorem systemRestriction_push_acyclic {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (source : SystemRestrictionData l E X)
    (c : R l E Y ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj (R l E X))
    [(push f c).Additive]
    (towerImage : RightImage
      ((Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj (push f c)))
    (I : CochainComplex (Systems l E X) ℤ) (hI : I.IsKInjective) :
    IsIso (towerImage.unit.app
      ((source.systemRestriction.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I))
